import * as React from "react";
import { Icon } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/icon";

import { Button } from "@/registry/erbium/ui/button";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuGroup,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuRadioGroup,
  DropdownMenuRadioItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
  DropdownMenuList,
} from "@/registry/erbium/ui/dropdown-menu";

export const DropdownMenuRadioIcons = () => {
  const [paymentMethod, setPaymentMethod] = React.useState("card");

  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <DropdownMenuTrigger render={<Button variant="outline" />}>
        Payment Method
      </DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuContent className="min-w-56">
        <DropdownMenuList>
          <DropdownMenuGroup>
            <DropdownMenuLabel>Select Payment Method</DropdownMenuLabel>
            <DropdownMenuRadioGroup value={paymentMethod} onValueChange={setPaymentMethod}>
              <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="card">
                <Icon name="credit-card" />
                Credit Card
              </DropdownMenuRadioItem>
              <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="paypal">
                <Icon name="wallet-01" />
                PayPal
              </DropdownMenuRadioItem>
              <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="bank">
                <Icon name="building-02" />
                Bank Transfer
              </DropdownMenuRadioItem>
            </DropdownMenuRadioGroup>
          </DropdownMenuGroup>
        </DropdownMenuList>
      </DropdownMenuContent>
    </DropdownMenu>
  );
};
